title: Progressive deployment orchestrator with safety validators
creator: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: Hosted API rollouts across regions have occasional regression windows when model/runtime versions are changed. We need an orchestrator that performs staged traffic progression (canary -> ramp -> regional fan-out) coupled with validators that gate progression based on live SLOs, error budget, and regression checks against a small prompt-based evaluation set. This ticket implements the core orchestration logic and the standard validator set for the hosted API path.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Orchestrator can create and execute a progressive rollout plan that starts with a canary (0.5-2% traffic) and performs time-boxed ramps to a target split across regions. 2) Progression is blocked if any validator raises a failure: 5xx rate spike above threshold, P99 latency regression > configured delta, error budget burn > configured threshold, or prompt-regression evaluation failure. 3) The orchestrator records each step as an auditable event and exposes a delta report in the Console rollout UI and via API. 4) Automatic rollback to previous stable variant if critical failure is detected during progression. 5) Comprehensive e2e tests and a runbook for on-call are present.
tasks: Design orchestration state machine and API contract for rollout plans
Implement validator interface: SLOChecker, LatencyChecker, PromptEvalChecker, HealthProbeChecker
Add traffic-shift executor capable of regional partial shifts and blue/green swaps
Integrate with Console: rollout events, manual override, and audit trail
Add metrics and tracing hooks (per-step SLI time series and tags)
Create canary sizing recommendations and default cadence (configurable)
Add automatic rollback policy and safe-fail open behavior for control-plane errors
Write e2e tests in staging simulating failures and validating rollback
Author runbook and include Slack + PagerDuty escalation examples
description_notes: Design decisions: prefer declarative rollout plans over imperative scripts so PMs and SREs can inspect and replay plans. Plans include ordered steps with expected observed metrics and allowed deviation ranges.
Trade-offs: tighter validators increase false-positive blocking. We'll start conservative (wider tolerances) and tighten after two successful LTS-based rollouts.
Compatibility: orchestrator must support both hosted models and dedicated model variants; treat model variant id and runtime image as interchangeable version keys for gating.
Data retention: store rollout events for 90 days by default and expose CSV export for audits.
testing_plan: Unit tests for validator logic. Integration tests against a staging metrics stream and fake traffic generator. e2e scenario: healthy canary -> ramp -> success. Failure scenario: injected 5xx spike during ramp should trigger immediate rollback and event recorded. Load test for traffic executor to verify <1s step latency when shifting 10k rps across regions.
runbook_outline: 1) Detect blocked rollout via Console alert or PagerDuty. 2) Review validator delta report (SLO, latency, prompt eval). 3) If transient, pause and allow one automatic retry; if sustained, rollback to previous variant using orchestrator rollback command. 4) Postmortem: collect sampler traces, console audit, and timeline from orchestrator events.
